family: The single total uniform one-bit Li sumset-extractor family fixed in proof.md, from Xin Li, ECCC TR23-023 revision 1 (30 May 2023), Theorem 7.13 and Definition 1.1, with constant error 1/8, fixed deterministic construction and fixed finite-length completion f_0=0.
theorem: For this fixed polynomial-time computable family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, liminf over all integer input lengths n of C_B2(f_n)/n is at least 62405759/12405759 in the full Li-Yang binary Boolean circuit model.
